question: Which figures complete the Sakala eight and begin the ten-Rudra list?
premises: The eighth of the Sakala group is the throat-and-lip one.
This Sakala group of eight is transmitted in the tradition.
The verse then names Omkara, Shiva, Dipta, Hetu, Isha, Dasheshaka, Sushiva, and Kala.
inference: The Sakala eight is completed and the enumeration continues into the ten-Rudra series.
uncertainties: The identity of the 'throat-and-lip' member is not fully explicit.
plain_english: The throat-and-lip one is the eighth, and this group of eight Saktalas is traditionally transmitted. Then are named Omkara, Shiva, Dipta, Hetu, Isha, Dasheshaka, Sushiva, and Kala.
